description: A dark cave lit by a campfire at the bottom edge. A heavy-browed, muscular hairy man with a bare chest and fur draped over him sits on the left, with one hand resting on a small child. A slimmer long-haired man in a fur coat sits on the right. A toddler in fur clothing sits between them, and sparks rise from the fire. Painterly, no visible text, border or frame.
